title: Clinical Lab Technician - Entry level, will train!

cond_0001.intro: The [Company name masked] division is seeking a Technician to join their team. [Company name masked] provides esoteric testing for hospitals and physician specialists, primarily specializing in endocrinology and GI testing. The goal is to provide premier laboratory services that positively impact patient care and cost-effective medical treatment. The Lab Technician will assist in specimen testing under direct and constant supervision according to established procedures, working under the oversight of a Clinical Laboratory Scientist.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Participate in specimen testing according to established procedures working under the technical oversight of a Clinical Lab Scientist
Record dates of receipt, in use, and expiration for all reagents, kits, controls, and standards used for assigned assays. Ensure material used is not expired prior to use
Perform pipetting using pre-set devices, calibrated and approved automatic devices or fixed volume dispensers
Perform preventative maintenance on equipment, document PM appropriately, and immediately contact appropriate personnel for problems requiring complex instrument repairs
Adhere to the standard operating procedures and safety requirements of [Company name masked], CLIA, CAP and other regulatory bodies
Document all activities as necessary including preventative maintenance logs, instrument function checks, troubleshooting, and quality control to ensure regulatory compliance
Develop an ever-increasing understanding of laboratory medicine and the clinical significance of laboratory results
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science, or medical technology or related fields of science from an accredited institution which includes a minimum 12 semester hours of chemistry
Must be able to pass a standardized color vision screen
High level of attention to detail along with strong communication and organizational skills
Ability to work independently and within a team environment
Preferred Requirements
At least one course of organic chemistry as part of the degree
Proficient with computers; familiarity with laboratory information systems is a plus
Ability to work in a fast paced environment
No previous experience required.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Adhere to the standard operating procedures and safety requirements of [Company name masked], CLIA, CAP and other regulatory bodies
Document all activities as necessary including preventative maintenance logs, instrument function checks, troubleshooting, and quality control to ensure regulatory compliance
Develop an ever-increasing understanding of laboratory medicine and the clinical significance of laboratory results

Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science, or medical technology or related fields of science from an accredited institution which includes a minimum 12 semester hours of chemistry preferably including at least one course of organic chemistry. Able to work independently and communicate well within a team
Proficient with computers; familiarity with laboratory information systems is a plus
Strong attention to detail along with solid communication and organizational skills
